card.name: Linking words before a named person or group
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas or brackets right before a proper name is expected, such as a person, party or place, in history, politics and news text.

modes.label: Link before a person's name
modes.description: A word like by, of, and, or honor sits right before the name of a historical or political figure.

modes.label: List openers before names
modes.description: A comma, bracket or conjunction in a list of named people or groups.

modes.label: Time word before an event
modes.description: A word like when that introduces a historical event with named actors.
modes.example: September 1996<< when>> the Taliban captured Kabul.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that come just before the name of a person, party or place.
